APPROVE
The method now just picks between two helpers, so its complexity is well under 15. Each extracted condition (`IsPayloadCall`, `IsForeignStatement`, the inverted `response.Length == 0 || !IsIdentifier` guard, the flattened `return` check) keeps the original logic and the dropped `k > 0` bound can never be false where it matters. I see no unused variables or unmatched doc tags that would break a warnings-as-errors build, though I couldn't build it here to confirm.
